cmd:
cd /opt/trading-bot/positions_regr && echo CFG && cat exit_cfg.json | /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -c "import json,sys; c=json.load(sys.stdin); print(json.dumps({k:c[k] for k in ('stop','be','trail','tp','tp1','sr') if k in c},ensure_ascii=False))" && POS_DIR=/opt/trading-bot/positions_regr /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import sys,json,urllib.request
sys.path.insert(0,'/opt/trading-bot/positions')
import exit_cfg
s=json.load(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:18102/api/claude',timeout=30))
p=[x for x in s['closed'] if x['id']==419][0]
cfg=exit_cfg.eff(p); L=exit_cfg.levels(p,cfg)
e=p['entry']
print('entry %.5f R %.5f R_pct %.3f'%(e,p['R'],p['R_pct']))
print('page shows (stored in position): be_px %.5f (%+.3f%%) lock_px %.5f (%+.3f%%) lock_pct field %s'%(p['be_px'],(p['be_px']/e-1)*100,p['lock_px'],(p['lock_px']/e-1)*100,p.get('lock_pct')))
print('engine levels now: be_px %.5f (%+.3f%%) lock_px %.5f (%+.3f%%) tp %s trail_dist %s'%(L['be_px'],(L['be_px']/e-1)*100,L['lock_px'],(L['lock_px']/e-1)*100,('%.5f'%L['tp']) if L['tp'] else None,L.get('trail_dist')))
for q in s['open']:
    c2=exit_cfg.eff(q); L2=exit_cfg.levels(q,c2); sd=1 if q['side']=='long' else -1
    print('open #%d %s: page be %+.3f%% lock %+.3f%% | engine be %+.3f%% lock %+.3f%% (в сторону прибыли)'%(q['id'],q['sym'],sd*(q['be_px']/q['entry']-1)*100,sd*(q['lock_px']/q['entry']-1)*100,sd*(L2['be_px']/q['entry']-1)*100,sd*(L2['lock_px']/q['entry']-1)*100))
EOF
